result.reason: The clause reaches the fallback position: it provides a mutual cap based on 12 months of fees paid or payable and carves out confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct; Section 8 appears to supply the indemnification carve-out. It does not reach the preferred position because it lacks the USD 1,000,000 floor and express carve-outs for data protection/security and IP infringement. The change from the filing of the claim to the event giving rise to liability is unnecessary and departs from the preferred measurement period. Also, stating that all “limitations” do not apply to the carve-outs is broader than merely making those liabilities uncapped and could disapply the consequential-damages exclusion.
